name: Doro Comfort 4005 Combo Phone
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk. Photo to be confirmed.
description: The Doro Comfort 4005 is a 2-in-1 combo — a big-button corded desk phone with the DECT base built in, plus a cordless handset on a charging cradle. Both handsets have TrueSound audio with up to +24 dB boost, large keys and a readable backlit display, and there's a 14-minute answering machine.
